cohort: The study included 25 women hospitalized in the ICU due to maternal sepsis.
finding: The Sepsis in Obstetrics Score (SOS) performed better in predicting the need for ICU stay longer than 72 hours, while the obstetric modified SOFA (omSOFA) score performed better in predicting septic shock.
mod_finding: Sepsis developed after cesarean section in 28% of patients and after vaginal delivery in 12% of patients.
